planets.name: Kepler-732 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-732 with a 0.893-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-732 c was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-732. Its orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
